post.description: The workflow step matching the requester's own domain is auto-approved immediately. For purchase-request, items[].noSpk is optional for the paper form; when supplied it must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk, otherwise 400 with errors keyed like items.0.noSpk. items[].itemId is optional and links the line to the catalog; an unknown id is a 400 keyed items.0.itemId, and a line without itemId stays free text. The same check applies on edit and resubmit.

post.description: Only the original requester may resubmit. Restarts the workflow at the first step. For purchase-request, items[].noSpk is optional for the paper form; when supplied it must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk, otherwise 400 with errors keyed like items.0.noSpk.

put.description: The original requester (or superadmin) with purchase-request.create can edit pending or revision_requested requests. Validates the same payload as creation, starts a new approval cycle and records the change in the audit log. Approved and rejected requests are locked.
